name: TON_IoT-Network
split: stratified random 70/15/15 by finest attack type (no usable time order)

dropped_columns.src_ip: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.dst_ip: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.src_port: raw client/server port: replaced by derived service_port (the lower, server-side port)
dropped_columns.dst_port: raw client/server port: replaced by derived service_port (the lower, server-side port)
dropped_columns.dns_query: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.ssl_subject: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.ssl_issuer: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.http_uri: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.http_user_agent: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries

derived_doc.service_port: lower non-zero of the two port numbers (server/service side); client ephemeral port discarded
derived_doc.len_*: character length of the raw string (bytes for hex payloads); 0 when absent
derived_doc.inj_*: count of injection-typical characters ' " < > % ; and '..' in the URI/query
derived_doc.__txt_http: HTTP method + first 80 chars of URI: used ONLY in the text descriptions, never as a tabular feature
